args.lesson: Bing's format=rss endpoint ignores the site: operator. Both queries returned HTTP 200 with 10 unrelated results each (Amazon for the CSV query, unrelated apps for the welfare query), so it cannot show whether a page is indexed. Absence of the owned URLs there tells us nothing. Worked: parsing the XML programmatically and classifying the result as unsupported query behavior rather than an empty index. Next time, check a surface with a control query (a known-indexed host) before relying on it, or skip index observation and judge experiments only on aggregate inbound feedback.
